long:
I’m Sharon Ona, a Certified Nutrition Specialist and the founder of Sharon Ona Functional Nutrition. I provide virtual nutrition counseling to adults across the U.S., focusing on cardiometabolic and hormone health, including high cholesterol, fatty liver, insulin resistance, prediabetes, type 2 diabetes, PCOS, and weight concerns. I love talking about food and finding creative ways to help clients make changes that feel doable in real life.

My approach is compassionate, curious, and collaborative. I bring nutrition expertise together with counseling, so you have room to talk through what’s working, what’s hard, and what feels doable next. Our one-hour sessions offer accountability and behavior change support, plus time to go over your labs and recipes and adjust your plan as life changes.

Insurance-based and private-pay options are available.
size: I am currently a solo practice. My schedule is open 5 days per week (Monday-Friday), 6 appointments per day, all appointments are scheduled for 60 minutes. Maximum 120 appointments per month, aiming for a minimum of 75% capacity.
